title: Azure Court Manual of the Twin Threads
summary: A school manual of the court on two threads of fate drawn together that ends in the entwined fates which bind a foe to the ruin they share with the user.

title: Canon of the Hawk and the Great Loom
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the great loom whose cloth is the pattern of the fight and that ends in the loom verdict.

title: Wind-Sworn Course of the Sworn Portent
summary: A school course in the portent that a wind-sworn student reads and swears to meet that ends in the sworn portent and its edict.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Destiny
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on a destiny that has no walls and may be turned by a bold hand and that ends in the unwalled destiny.
